from wo_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id
mapper.insert: insert into wo_order (order_no, title, category_id, category_code, category_name, source_type, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_phone, applicant_dept_id, applicant_dept_name, location, urgency_level, impact_scope, description, possible_cause, status, sla_rule_id, response_deadline, arrival_deadline, finish_deadline, sla_reminder_before_min, sla_allow_extension, submitted_at, version, create_by, create_time, del_flag) values (#{orderNo}, #{title}, #{categoryId}, #{categoryCode}, #{categoryName}, #{sourceType}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{applicantPhone}, #{applicantDeptId}, #{applicantDeptName}, #{location}, #{urgencyLevel}, #{impactScope}, #{description}, #{possibleCause}, #{status}, #{slaRuleId}, #{responseDeadline}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{finishDeadline}, #{slaReminderBeforeMin}, #{slaAllowExtension}, #{submittedAt}, #{version}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, '0')
mapper.select: select from wo_order o where o.id = #{id} and o.del_flag = '0' for update
mapper.update:
update wo_order set status = #{targetStatus}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{actionTime}
, current_assignee_id = #{engineerId}, current_assignee_name = #{engineerName}, assigned_at = #{actionTime}, accepted_at = null, arrived_at = null, processing_at = null, finished_at = null
, delay_pending_flag = '0'
, accepted_at = #{actionTime}, response_overdue = case when response_deadline is not null and #{actionTime} > response_deadline then '1' else response_overdue end, overdue_flag = case when response_deadline is not null and #{actionTime} > response_deadline then '1' else overdue_flag end
, arrived_at = #{actionTime}, processing_at = coalesce(processing_at, #{actionTime}), arrival_overdue = case when arrival_deadline is not null and #{actionTime} > arrival_deadline then '1' else arrival_overdue end, overdue_flag = case when arrival_deadline is not null and #{actionTime} > arrival_deadline then '1' else overdue_flag end
, processing_at = coalesce(processing_at, #{actionTime})
, finished_at = #{actionTime}, delay_pending_flag = '0', finish_overdue = case when coalesce(extension_deadline, finish_deadline) is not null and #{actionTime} > coalesce(extension_deadline, finish_deadline) then '1' else finish_overdue end, overdue_flag = case when coalesce(extension_deadline, finish_deadline) is not null and #{actionTime} > coalesce(extension_deadline, finish_deadline) then '1' else overdue_flag end
, confirmed_at = #{actionTime} , closed_at = #{actionTime} where id = #{id} and status = #{sourceStatus} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select from wo_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.status in ('WAIT_ASSIGN', 'WAIT_ACCEPT', 'ACCEPTED', 'PROCESSING') order by o.id
select from wo_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.status = 'COMPLETED' and o.confirmed_at is not null and o.confirmed_at <= #{confirmedBefore} order by o.confirmed_at, o.id limit 500
mapper.update: update wo_order set status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = #{closedAt}, version = version + 1, update_by = 'auto-close', update_time = #{closedAt} where id = #{id} and status = 'COMPLETED' and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
